FN-FNN9CDD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 37
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/05/2025
House Bill 37 as introduced would increase the obligations of the following entities by the
following estimated amounts, paid from the State General Fund for judicial compensation,
according to the Administrative Office of Courts, by permitting the use of bench experience for
certain state court judgeships that are elected or appointed to an appellate court or the supreme
court:
Agency FY 2025 FY 2026 & thereafter
Supreme Court $13,500 $40,600
Court of Criminal Appeals $8,800 $24,200
Court of Civil Appeals $4,800 $14,400
Total $27,100 $72,200
